html_content:
Private music lessons by highly qualified teachers!

From Beginners to Advanced!

Courses are taught by highly qualified teachers in professional studio classrooms. Programs are customized based on students' age, specific goals and music genres, ranging from rock to R&B to jazz and classical.

Program Features

  • Professional concerts – some of the largest amateur concerts in Canada
  • RCM exam preparation with internationally recognized credentials
  • Band performance opportunities with experienced instructors
  • Customized programs based on age, goals, and music genres
